data.body_html:
Planning a stag weekend in Marbella and wondering what a boat rental actually costs? For 2026, prices start at €749 for two hours on a Tier A boat like the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, and go up to €4,719 for four hours on a Mangusta 80 with a free jet ski. Every charter includes a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA — no surprises. This breakdown covers every boat in our fleet, what you get for your money, and how to pick the best option for your group.

Marbella stag weekend boat rental cost breakdown 2026

The table below shows the firm pricing for our two main tiers. All other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp — just ask for a quote tailored to your group size and duration.

BoatLengthCapacityPrice (2h)Price (4h)Price (8h)
Astondoa 4012.5m9 pax€749—€2,299
Azimut 3912.5m11 pax€749—€2,299
Mangusta 80 (white or grey)24m12 pax—€4,719—

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. Mangusta 80 includes a free jet ski.

What you get for your money: inclusions explained

Every charter — regardless of boat — includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You don’t need to bring anything except sunscreen and a good attitude. The skipper handles navigation, mooring, and safety, so you can focus on celebrating.

Boat options for stag groups: from budget to luxury

If your group is 9–11 people and you want the best value, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal. For a larger group of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) offers serious wow factor and a free jet ski. Other boats like the Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, or Maiora 26m are available on request — perfect if you want a longer charter or extra space. Smaller boats (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) work for groups of 5, but for a stag do, we usually recommend the bigger options.

Where you’ll cruise: Puerto Banús to the best coves

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, the most famous marina on the Costa del Sol. From there, you can cruise to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for swimming, anchor off the Golden Mile for views of La Concha, or head toward Estepona for a longer trip. The skipper will suggest a route based on your group’s preferences and the day’s conditions.

How to book and what to expect

Booking is straightforward: choose your boat, pick a date, and contact us via WhatsApp for availability. We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks ahead for 2026 weekends, especially for the Mangusta 80. Payment is typically required in advance to secure the slot. On the day, meet at Puerto Banús, board, and set off. The skipper will give a brief safety rundown, then it’s champagne and cruising.

Tips for a successful stag boat day

  • Bring swimwear, towels, and sunscreen — the Mediterranean sun is strong even in spring.
  • Plan for a mix of cruising, swimming, and chilling — 2 hours is enough for a quick taste, but 4 or 8 hours allows for a proper party.
  • If you want music, bring a Bluetooth speaker (the boat’s sound system may vary).
  • Remember that the skipper is there for safety — respect their instructions, especially regarding alcohol consumption.
  • Consider combining the boat trip with a night out in Puerto Banús — the marina is steps away from the best bars and clubs.

Frequently asked questions

What is included in a Marbella stag weekend boat rental?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees.

How much does a stag boat rental cost in Marbella for 2026?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What is the maximum group size for a stag boat in Marbella?

Most boats carry up to 12 passengers (Mangusta 80, Azimut 58, Ferretti 94, Maiora 26m). Smaller boats like the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 take 5 people. Check each boat's capacity before booking.

Do we need to bring our own drinks or food?

No. All charters include soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. You are welcome to bring additional food or drinks, but the standard package already covers the basics.

Can we depart from a marina other than Puerto Banús?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús. It is the most convenient and iconic marina for a stag weekend, with easy access to Marbella's nightlife and nearby coves like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés.

Is a skipper included, and can we drive the boat ourselves?

A licensed skipper is included on every charter. For safety and legal reasons, guests cannot drive the boat. The skipper handles navigation, mooring, and ensures a smooth trip.

What happens if the weather is bad on our stag weekend?

If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we will reschedule or offer a full refund. Marbella enjoys over 300 sunny days a year, so bad weather is rare, especially from April to October.

How far in advance should we book for a 2026 stag weekend?

We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks ahead, especially for summer weekends and Tier B yachts. Early booking ensures availability and better slot choices.
